article.title_es: Christ Church United Methodist: comedor en Manhattan
article.title_en: Christ Church United Methodist: soup kitchen in Manhattan
article.summary_es: Christ Church United Methodist aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como lugar de comida. Ofrece un comedor (soup kitchen) los domingos por la tarde en Manhattan.
article.summary_en: Christ Church United Methodist is listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It offers a soup kitchen on Sunday afternoons in Manhattan.
how_they_help_es: Aparece en el mapa oficial Food Help NYC como lugar de comida.
Ofrece un comedor (soup kitchen) los domingos de 4:30pm a 6pm.
Está ubicado en 524 Park Ave, Nueva York, NY 10065, en Manhattan.
Se puede llamar al (212) 838-3036 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: Listed on the official Food Help NYC map as a food help location.
Offers a soup kitchen on Sundays from 4:30pm to 6pm.
Located at 524 Park Ave, New York, NY 10065, in Manhattan.
You can call (212) 838-3036 to ask questions before visiting.
visit_tips_es: El horario indicado es domingo de 4:30pm a 6pm (comedor).
La lista no dice qué alimentos se entregan ni si hay requisitos, así que conviene preguntar por teléfono.
Llame al (212) 838-3036 antes de ir para confirmar el servicio.
visit_tips_en: The listed hours are Sunday 4:30pm-6pm (soup kitchen).
The listing does not say what food is given or any requirements, so it is best to ask by phone.
Call (212) 838-3036 before visiting to confirm the service.
